params.name: Width
params.description: Size of the sheet along X in world units.

params.name: Length
params.description: Size of the sheet along Z in world units.

params.name: Columns
params.description: Number of quad divisions across the width (X). More columns give a finer sheet.

params.name: Rows
params.description: Number of quad divisions along the length (Z). More rows give a finer sheet.

params.name: Center X
params.description: X position of the sheet's center in world units.

params.name: Center Y
params.description: Height of the flat sheet in world units; the plane lies level in XZ at this Y.

params.name: Center Z
params.description: Z position of the sheet's center in world units.

params.name: Color
params.description: When on, colors the points with a gradient across the sheet; when off, the plane uses the plain default color.
